searchSpace.description: A map of hyperparameters to their parameter spaces.

title:
This type represents a search space for a set of hyperparameters. Each hyperparameter within this space has its own
{@link Hp.ParamSpace} that defines all possible values for that hyperparameter. When put together, an
{@link Hp.SearchSpace} represents the space of all valid combinations of the specified hyperparameters.
name: Hp.SearchSpace
